name: Ciutadilla (Spain)
description: Blue field with a white flamed wavy band rising diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, with the white and blue barry shield of the marquesses of Ciutadilla in the upper hoist.
history: The flag of Ciutadilla is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, blue, with a white flamed diagonal ascending stripe, wavy with three crests, of thickness at its start of 1/3 of the width of the cloth; in the hoist canton, the arms of the marquesses of Ciutadilla. It was published in the DOGC on 30 October 1997.
